transcript.content: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I came in because... I know this sounds a bit hard to explain, but I’ve been completely convinced lately that one of my MBA classmates and a startup advisor are quietly coordinating opportunities for me. It's like... certain comments they make in class, or even just regular Slack messages, are actually coded signals about where my career is supposed to go. I just felt like I needed to come in and talk to someone about it.
When you think about these coded messages from your classmates and the advisor, do you have any doubt that this is actually happening, or are you completely certain this coordination is real?

Well, to me, I'm completely convinced it's real. I mean, I know it sounds strange when I try to explain it out loud, but when I'm actually reading those Slack messages or hearing their comments during class... I don't have any doubt at all. 

It just makes perfect sense to me that they are sending me these coded signals to guide my career. So, yeah, I am completely certain it's happening.
Besides the coded messages in the Slack messages and comments, have you been hearing voices or seeing things that other people around you don't seem to notice?

Um, yeah, actually, I have. It's not all the time, but maybe a few times a week. Usually it happens when I’m working late on school stuff or my operations plans. I'll just... hear my name, or sometimes a really short phrase like "go now." It sounds so clear that I actually stop and check my phone, or I look around the room to see who said it, even though I'm completely alone and no one else is there.
How long have you been experiencing these coded messages and hearing your name being called? When did this all start?

It's been going on for about two months now. I think it all really started right around the time I began my part-time MBA prerequisite program. I've been keeping my regular operations job at the same time, so... yeah, I'd say it's been about two months since all this started.
Before these two months when the MBA program started, would you say you were functioning normally—going to work, managing relationships, and not having any unusual beliefs or experiences like these?

Yeah, before all this started, everything was pretty normal. I was just working my regular job, seeing friends, doing all the usual stuff. Before this whole stretch of feeling so energized and driven with the MBA program, I never had anything like this happen. I never felt like messages were coded, and I definitely never heard my name being called when no one was around. All of those experiences really only started once my mood kind of shifted and my workload got so intense with the prerequisites. Before that, I didn't have any of these unusual experiences at all.

When you say your mood shifted and you felt more energized and driven during the MBA program, did you notice that you needed much less sleep than usual but still felt full of energy, or did you feel like your thoughts were racing?

Yeah, my thoughts have definitely been racing. I do have a ton of energy, but my mind just... it jumps around constantly. I'll be thinking about market expansion for my job, and then suddenly I'm focused on my MBA coursework, and then org charts, and then I'm planning out moving abroad. It all goes so fast that I'll literally open up five different documents on my computer, and then I completely forget which idea I was even trying to write down first. It's just moving a million miles a minute.

During these past two months when you've been feeling so energized and your thoughts are racing, how would you describe your overall mood? Do you feel unusually happy, excited, or irritable most of the time?

Well, most days I've felt unusually... switched on, I guess. Really optimistic, like I'm right on the edge of something huge with my career and the MBA. But at the same time, I've noticed I'm getting really irritable. I'll just snap at my teammates at work, or at my boyfriend, over really small delays that normally wouldn't bother me at all. It's like I'm super excited but also just... easily frustrated if things aren't moving as fast as I am.

Before these past two months, have you ever had a period lasting several weeks or longer where you felt very depressed, had much less energy than usual, lost interest in things you normally enjoy, or had trouble sleeping significantly more than usual?

No, I haven't really had anything like that. I mean, I've had days where I felt a bit down or tired, like anyone else, but never for weeks at a time. I've always been pretty consistent with my energy and mood before all this MBA stuff started. I never really lost interest in my hobbies or had any major issues with sleeping too much or feeling super depressed. So, no, nothing like that.
Have you ever had a period in your life, even before these past two months, where you felt this same kind of high energy, racing thoughts, and irritability for several days or weeks in a row?

No, I don't think so. This is really the first time I've experienced anything like this. Before these past couple of months, my energy levels and mood were always pretty stable. I've never had a time where my mind was racing like this or where I felt this kind of intense energy and irritability for days on end. It's all very new to me.

During these past two months, have you noticed that you need significantly less sleep than you normally do—like sleeping only 3-4 hours a night—but still feel well-rested and full of energy the next day?

No, I haven't really noticed that. I mean, my sleep has been pretty normal. I'm still getting my usual seven or eight hours a night. I definitely haven't been running on just three or four hours or anything like that... I just have all this energy when I am awake.

Have you ever had any period in your life, even a brief one, where you felt unusually energetic, needed very little sleep, had racing thoughts, or felt unusually confident or on top of the world—even if it only lasted a few days?

No, I really haven't. Like I said, this whole experience over the past couple of months is completely new for me. I've never had any time in the past where I felt overly confident, or had racing thoughts, or needed less sleep. My mood and energy have always just been normal and steady before all this started.

I want to make sure I'm not missing anything from your past. Has there ever been a time—even just a few days—where you felt like you could get by on much less sleep than usual and still feel fine, without feeling tired the next day?

No, honestly, there hasn't. I know you're trying to be thorough, but... no. I've always been someone who needs a full night's sleep to function. Even just a few days of getting by on less sleep and feeling fine? That's never happened to me before this current situation.
